events.description: A great and entertaining look back at this classic Showa Era movie. Be there to learn about Gamera 's first adversary.

events.title: Godzilla, King of the Monsters Turns 70
events.description: Two years after first appearing in Japan, Godzilla, King of the Monsters made its way to North America. Heavily, but respectfully edited and modified with new actors and sets, the film was a hit and ensured years of further kaiju action Stateside!

events.title: G-Cinema Author Daniel DiManna Interview
events.description: Fresh off the press, G-Cinema: An Exploration and Celebration of Japan's Monster King is the NEWEST book tackling the Big G and his compatriots for their 70 years of history. Podcaster Elijah Thomas interviews author Daniel DiManna about the content of his book and the process behind crafting such a project.

events.title: Ultraman Mebius - 20 Years
events.description: A panel discussing the planning for, production of, surrounding merchandise, and impact of Ultraman Mebius alongside companion media pieces ULTRAMAN 2: REQIUEM, Ultraman Mebius & Ultraman Brothers, Ultraman Story 0, Ultraman Fighting Evolution 0, Super 8 Ultra Brothers, etc. in celebration of the show's 20th anniversary. This panel will detail Tsuburaya Production's troubled history leading to Mebius, its successes and failures, its achievements and cultivated legacy, and the impact it left on the franchise at large.

events.title: Ultraman TCG Deck Building
events.description: Learn to build your structured deck with Ultraman Card Game Ambassadors.  We will teach you how to take your starters and booster to curate decks around the different Ultras with some sneak peeks at BP08 in new release!

events.title: Kaiju Assault & Monster Match - Free Play
Art Display
events.description: General Room Hours

events.title: Secrets Of Godzilla 2000
events.description: Uncover the mysteries of Godzilla 2000: Toho's bold reboot in the Millennium era! Our panel Our panel reveals the secrets from this Godzilla's origins to the birth of Orga. Explore the fierce suit design, behind-the-scenes trivia, and themes of nature vs. hubris. A must for fans: rare insights and exclusive behind the scenes footage and photos of this underrated gem!

events.title: Godzilla and Japan
events.description: A Kaiju fan's dream holiday destination. Why every fan should complete this pilgrimage and how to make it happen.

events.title: I Can't Believe It's Not Godzilla
events.description: A retrospective of different Godzilla-like creatures throughout cinema and literary history.

events.title: Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker Premiere Public Showin
events.description: Included as a bonus film for the Blu-ray release of Brush of the God, Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker is a one-of-a-kind English documentary that covers the life and legacy of Keizo Murase, one of the godfathers of the kaiju genre. From Godzilla and Gamera to Mothra and Ultraman, Murase helped bring generations of iconic monsters to life. In attendance will be the co-writer and director, Elijah Thomas, as well as various members of the crew. After the premiere, attendees are invited to a live Q&A exploring the making of the documentary and Keizo Murase's works.

events.title: Introduction to Starting Your Kaiju Zoo
events.description: Have you ever considered collecting kaiju figures, re-painting or re-posing them, or building models of them in styrene, vinyl, resin or any other form? Join the team to discuss the vast universe of kaiju figures and how you can get started creating your very own Kaiju Zoo!

events.title: How Marusan's Sofvi are made PART 2
events.description: Part 2 of the Marusan factory series goes deeper into sofvi painting with Eiji Kaminaga. Featuring video footage of celebrated toy painter Goto-san, this panel explores the process and artistry that transform vinyl into collectible art.

events.title: G-Pardy: Kids Game
events.description: The game made for trivia buffs in the kaiju community, G-Pardy, is back and looking for contestants to test their mental mettle. Kids, here is your game if you think you're a trivia champ of all things kaiju then prove it in this Jeopardy game, G-Pardy!

events.title: Shin Godzilla: 10 Years Later
events.description: In 2016 Toho brought back Godzilla after a 12 year hiatus with one of the largest and most terrifying incarnations at the time. With Hideaki Anno (creator of Neon Genesis Evangelion) at the helm, the movie was not only a big success but reaffirmed the enduring demand for Japanese-made G-films in the West and set the stage for the resurgence of Toho’s Godzilla that we’ve seen in recent years.

events.title: Kaiju Assault: Monster Match - Learn to Play
Godzilla TCG Deck Building
events.description: Learn to build your structured deck with Godzilla Card Game Ambassadors.  We will teach you how to take your starters and booster to curate decks around the different Kaiju with some sneak peeks at the latest Godzilla TCG releases!

events.title: Tyrannocircus Rex
events.description: Set in 1918, Rose helps her younger sister Jessie, escape from an orphanage. Pursued by the man who runs the orphanage, they all end up at a rather peculiar circus, where all the animal acts feature dinosaurs, instead of lions, tigers, and elephants. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: Dragon Lizard Lord vs Gorilla Monkey King
events.description: Typhon invades America. Zeus hits Miami and storms inland to crush Washington DC and clash with the mighty Dragon Lizard Lord in the ultimate battle of the big boys. In a panicked stricken madness the humans unleash giant Robots. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: Learn How to Sculpt with Nick Sparger
events.description: Sculptor and artist Nick Sparger has sculpted original busts for Black Heart models and more. Join him for a hands-on introduction to sculpting. Create kaiju from the Ultraman or Godzilla series, or bring your own original visions to life.

events.title: Unmade Aurora Kaiju Models
events.description: From 1962 until the mid-1970s, Aurora Models made waves with several lines of monster models. King Kong and Godzilla were the only giant monsters to make it into their original line. Rodan and Ghidrah, designed by artist Dave Cockrum appeared in the "Monsters of the Movies" lineup in the mid-1970s. Cockrum had grand ideas for expanding this model line that never came to pass. Come learn about what might have been.

events.title: Kaiju On Home Video
events.description: Over the past 50 years, we've gone from being completely unable to own any kaiju movies, to being able to watch them at the click of a button. This panel runs through the complete history of kaiju on home video from VHS to Laserdisc to Streaming and everything in between. Learn about rare, lost, rescued, and "trapped" films & tv shows across all home formats! Hosted by kaiju video super collector Kiefer Beelman and Seismic Toys co-founder Alex Rushdy.

events.title: CONQUEST! Ultraman TCG Tournament
events.description: The ultimate CONQUEST!  Join us for the ultimate showdown with your favorite Ultraman TCG as you rally your Ultras (or build your Kaiju!) to conquer and win amazing prizes in a sealed deck format.  Exclusive Ultraman promos and CONQUEST! prizing will be up for grabs.  This event features a highly sought after UD01 English Edition box that you simply can't find anywhere else.  A $500 value!

events.title: Ultraman Unreleased in the US
events.description: Most of the Ultraman franchise has come to North america in recent years, but not everything. This panel will be an overview of titles not yet localized.

events.title: Cosplay Showcase
events.description: Want to strut your stuff in Cosplay but not ready for the big stage? The Cosplay Showcase is for you! Just sign up in person the day of and have your moment in the limelight!

events.title: Akira Ifukube - 20 Years On
events.description: A tribute to Akira Ifukube on the 20th Anniversary of his death - A deep dive into the music of Akira Ifukube: how it defined the Toho films of the 50s, 60s and 90s, and continues to impact the kaiju genre to this day.

events.title: 60th Anniversary: Daimajin
events.description: In 1966, Daiei produced three films following the Mighty Majin of Terror! Kaiju Historians Eliajh Thomas and Danny DiManna pull back the curtain of this legendary trilogy and break down some of the hidden influences and pieces of history that are as mystic as the Majin himself.

events.title: LIVE Tokusatsu Filming
events.description: Every year our volunteer team writes, directs, and films a short film using original characters in a home-made style of Tokusatsu all in a single weekend - G-FEST weekend! All in the hopes it will inspire you to create your own tokusatsu film too…

events.title: Kaiju University
events.description: Kaiju University is an opportunity for folks who have limited experience with building and painting model kaiju. Includes a terrific resin kit, paint, building tools, patient instruction and supper! $100 registration.

events.title: Kaiju Village
events.description: Communal building event for experienced modellers. Bring your unbuilt or unfinished models and build together in a maker’s space. Share techniques and inspire each other.

events.title: Kaiju Kingdom Podcast
events.description: Chris Eaton and Jessica Tseang discuss Tim Seeley's entire Godzilla series (IDW Godzilla, TMNT X Godzilla, Godzilla-Kai Sei: End of the Reign etc), and his prolific career in comics.

events.title: The Lost World 101
events.description: A celebration of 101 years of one of the prototypical kaiju films, The Lost World (1925), walking through the film's background, plot, and influence. As well, asking whether it's still worth watching today

events.title: Outerman
events.description: An alien impersonating a TV icon brainwashes Japan in this action comedy. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: 40 Years of Screen-Used Kaiju Suits and Props
events.description: What happens to the suits and props after a film is finished? I will talk about this, accompanied by a photo tour of the many exhibitions and set visits I have witnessed, showing the suits and props that I have been able to see over the years.

events.title: TCG Free Play - Ultraman and Godzilla
events.description: It's open season with the latest TCGs and deckbuilding with our Pop Culture USA Ambassadors there to help you enjoy your favorite card games

events.title: Kaiju Writers Unite
events.description: The G-Fest tradition continues—now under new management! Come pick the brains of our panel of monster-loving authors to learn the art and craft of creating compelling kaiju fiction. No question is too big or small. They’ll even answer your general writing questions or inquiries about the publishing process. Panelists include the new full-time proprietors Nathan Marchand (Destroyer, Attack of the Kaiju 2-4, etc.), Daniel DiManna (Godzilla Novelization Project, etc.), and their cadre of kaiju creators. This is the warmup to the second annual kaiju writers workshop.

events.title: Yonggary 1999: The Best Worst Kaiju Movie of All Time
events.description: In the late 90s, director Shim Hyung-Rae set out to remake Yongary. What was supposed to be the best and biggest movie in the history of South Korean cinema turned out to be nothing short of a train wreck and a textbook example of "So bad, it's good". Join our group of panelists for a retrospective on one of the most infamous kaiju films ever made.

events.title: The Anacondas
events.description: Deep in Mexican ruins, archaeologists discover an ancient culture devoted to snake worship. Their excitement fades when they accidentally unleash a massive, ravenous anaconda that's been dormant for centuries. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: Den Ace: Chaos
events.description: A world beset by strange phenomena. A country in desperate need of super-heroics. And a skyscraper-sized hero who... well, he's trying his best. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: TITANVELL 3D Wargame Playtest
events.description: At night the entire zone dims the lights and we enter the TITANVEIL warzone where epic Kaiju strike your 3D Lunar Fortress. You can defend it with your choice of epic mechanical machinery, your own pet Kaiju, or even something more secretive... There's only one way to find out! Assemble your spacecraft, build your lunar base, choose your Kaiju or Mech and grab a chair to get started! It's compatible with any brand of Kaiju or Mecha or Ultra, so bring your collectibles and join the game.

events.title: Gladio: Monster Battle In The Alternative Dimension
events.description: After a sudden accident during a date, a young man awakens in a desolate alternative dimension alongside his childhood sweetheart. Forced into a brutal monster battle against the terrifying Kaiju Gladio, they must uncover the mystery of their arrival and fight for their survival to return to the real world. World Premiere Weekend

events.title: Zarkorr! The Invader
events.description: A young reporter is writing a story about the theories of scientist who believes dinosaurs still exist. When monsters suddenly appear and cause destruction, the doctor and journalist must find a way to save the world.

events.title: Yuzo The Biggest Battle In Tokyo
events.description: A giant monster uses the chaos of the COVID-19 pandemic to its advantage while an "everyman" named Yuzo is the only sane man that can stop it.

events.title: The Wad: The True Story Behind the Phantom Lake County Chewing Gum Disaster
events.description: The True Story Behind the Phantom Lake County Chewing Gum Disaster.

events.title: Space Monster Wangmawi
events.description: Aliens from another world seeking the conquest of Earth invade with flying saucers. They unleash a gigantic monster called Wang Ma Gwi, who destroys everything in its path with a powerful death ray.

events.title: Attack Of The Giant Teacher
events.description: Kenzo Miyazawa is an earnest teacher who works at a night high school. His class is filled with unique and slightly odd students. Suddenly, the night school witnesses a drop in student numbers and has no choice but to shut down by the end of the year. Mr. Miyazawa's class decides to create a musical for the school's last festival. Then, an alien beast invades Earth and begins destroying the town. Mr. Miyazawa challenges the alien beast to a fight.

events.title: The Great Buddha Arrival
events.description: The Shurakuen Buddha statue, located in Aichi, suddenly springs to his feet and wanders around Nagoya city.

events.title: Fish Tales
events.description: Joe's simple day of fishing is interrupted by a water nymph, and then he runs into a bigger catch than he could believe. Joe now has has to simply survive the day in this Fantasy comedy inspired by the works of Willis O'Brien, and Ray Harryhausen. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: King Chong
events.description: A young couple on a hiking quest for wild weed, find much more than they bargained for in this "high on laughs" wilderness romp. This is my King Kong, Willis O'Brien, and Ray Harryhausen homage. Shot in 2009, the film , for numerous reasons was actually not completed till 2021. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: Cape Cod Cthulhu
events.description: On a quiet weekend out on Cape Cod, three teenagers enjoy their spring break vacation. A theater troupe, the three young women rehearse their lines to Edgar Allen Poe's the Raven while enjoying the quiet beaches around them. While on a hike, they find an ancient relic that holds powers none of them fully understand as it awakens the Great Old One, Cthulhu. Unbeknownst to them, they have unleashed the ghost of HP Lovecraft along with some other famous figures that begin to terrorize the tourists. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: Godzilla v. Gene Kelly
events.description: People don't generally think of Godzilla and Gene Kelly at the same time, because they have nothing to do with each other…or do they? Are kaiju fights and dance routines more similar than people realize? Are kaiju movies actually structured like musicals? What about special effects? Ryan George Collins (Omni Viewer, author) and Nathan Marchand (The Monster Island Film Vault, author), take a look at how these two genres actually have a lot in common.

events.description: Explore different painting techniques for styrene, vinyl, and resin monsters. Learn easy methods to improve the look of your unique kaiju kits.

events.title: The Film Era vs. The Digital Era
events.description: A look at how the shift from film to digital changed the feel of kaiju cinema. Through side-by-side clips, we explore texture, lighting, color, and camera style to reveal the subtle craft changes that reshaped giant monster movies across generations.

events.title: Kaiju Aesthetic: Tracing the Visual DNA of Giant Monsters
events.description: This panel will provide an overview of the less-discussed intertwining artistic, historical, and theological precedents that led to the birth and visual development of kaiju across media—pre-modern, modern, and post-modern. Areas overviewed will range from the influences of East Asian prehistoric Japanese earthenware (eg. Jōmon) and Esoteric Buddhist statuary (eg. Wisdom Kings) to early North american cryptozoology and monster movies and 18th and 19th century European Romanticism.

events.title: Earliest Kaiju Fiction
events.description: Join professor of Japanese literature Jeffrey Angles and cultural studies scholar Justin Mullis for a wide ranging and exciting discussion of the earliest examples of kaiju prose fiction from both Japan and America. What inspired these authors? How do these works compare stylistically with each other? What were the working conditions and compensation like for their writers? What was the commercial and critical reception of their work? All this and more!

events.description: In-depth session on creating vignettes and dioramas to show off your kaiju models. Create scale, drama and vivid life for your creations.

events.title: European Kaiju Boom of 1961
events.description: You likely know about the “kaiju boom” of the 1960s in Japan, but have you heard of the boom in Europe in 1961? While Toho’s Mothra was revolutionizing the genre in Japan, three (in)famous “Euro-kaiju” movies also released that year: Gorgo and Konga in Britain and Reptilicus in Denmark. Author/podcaster Nathan Marchand and actor/podcaster Damon Noyes take you on a deep dive into these less-than-flattering (but still entertaining) imitators of King Kong and Godzilla.

events.title: Cosplay Contest Orientation
events.description: All registered contestants for the Cosplay Contest are required to attend this orientation session.

events.title: The Year of Mothra
events.description: Jessica Tseang, Chris Eaton, and Donny Winter (2025 Eisner winner), celebrate the history of the Queen of the Monsters from her 1961 debut, the Rebirth of Mothra, her unforgettable moments in Godzilla X Kong: New Empire, her future with Legendary, and why she has resonated with so many fans for over 50 years. Additional panelists may appear.

events.title: Q&A with Donald F. Glut
events.description: He's a musician. He’s an author. He’s a filmmaker. He’s a paleontologist. He’s the one and only Donald F. Glut! Although he couldn’t make it to Chicago this year, he will be appearing live via the internet for a special Q&A panel! Ryan George Collins (Omni Viewer, author) will be the most superfluous host in history as he selects the questions and lets Dinosaur Don go to town. Nathan Marchand (The Monster island Film Vault, author) cohosts and handles the technical stuff.

events.title: 70th Anniversary of Rodan
events.description: Join the author of Godzilla: The First 70 Years as he discusses the first color kaiju film. From the original story to theatrical release in the states, with a bonus look at the recent recreation of the Iwataya Dept Store set.

events.title: 30th Anniversary of Rebirth of Mothra
events.description: In 1996, with the Godzilla series on hiatus, Toho turned to Mothra to lead a new franchise. Rebirth of Mothra was the first of three films depicting Mothra defending the Earth against various kaiju. Our panelists will discuss this unusual entry in kaiju lore.

events.title: Meet Model and Monster Master Artist Yuji Kaida
events.description: Join master artist Yuji Kaida for a discussion about his art, his passion for illustrating kaiju, and his long history with fandom.

events.title: Otakumerica's Sofubi Crash Course
events.description: Join Otakumerica for a brief introduction to the world of sofubi collecting! Discover how they're made, their history, and where to start on your collecting journey!

events.title: Ultraman Tiga - 30 years
events.description: A panel discussing the planning for, creation of, reception, and impact of Ultraman Tiga to celebrate its 30th anniversary. The panel seeks to talk about behind the scenes information on Tiga's conception, its general reception at the time, what it pioneered for the franchise, its surrounding merchandise, and its lasting impact on the Ultraman series.

events.title: Kaiju Writers Creation Seminar
events.description: You had your questions answered by the kaiju writers at the Q&A panel, and now it’s time to show your work! Bring a new short story (or story pitch) to be shared with a small group of fellow aspiring writers to get feedback on your tale. You’ll even have a chance to get it published. Fanfiction is welcome.

events.title: Akira Toriyama: The Man, The Myth...The Kaiju Superfan?!?!
events.description: Akira Toriyama is world-famous as the creator of Dragon Ball. People know Goku and Vegeta as well as Superman and Wolverine. But there's a huge side to Toriyama that flies over the head of anime fans. The side that would appeal directly to the G-Fest crowd: The side that was a kaiju-sized fan of giant monster movies. This panel will delve into the many times Akira Toriyama referenced the world of kaiju eiga in his manga over the course of his career, with homages to Ultraman, Gamera, and of course, the King of the Monsters himself! This is a panel that will open up kaiju fans to a new avenue for their fandom to explore and and enlighten people to a rarely-discussed side of one of the world's most famous mangaka.

events.title: TCG Free Play - Ultraman and Godzilla
events.description: It's open season with the latest TCGs and deckbuilding with our Pop Culture USA Ambassadors there to help you enjoy your favorite card games

events.title: King Kong 10th Anniversary
events.description: A 10th Anniversary showing of this retelling of the Kong story.

events.title: Collect All Monsters Live
events.description: Hear the tales of toy makers from conception to production. Collect All Monsters showcases the process and the personal perspectives from sofubi slingers in Japan and beyond!

events.title: Understanding Mothra: Cultural, Political, Religious, and Artistic Perspectives
events.description: Toho has proclaimed 2026 “The Year of Mothra! Join Mothra comic book artist and writer Matt Frank (Mothra: Queen of the Monsters, Godzilla: Rulers of the Earth), Dr. Jeffrey Angles, Professor of Japanese Literature at Western Michigan University (translator and commentator The Luminous Fairies and Mothra; Godzilla and Godzilla Raids Again), and Dr. Russell W. Dalton, Professor of Religious Education at Brite Divinity School (author of Faith Journey through Fantasy Lands; Marvelous Myths; and panelist for “Female Kaiju in the Godzilla Universe” at Comic-Con Int'l 2025), as they share their insights and expertise on Mothra. These panelists will offer perspectives on Mothra’s origins in literature, reception in Japanese and the U.S. films, and on creating new stories of Mothra through comic books and art.

events.title: TITANVELL 3D Wargame Playtest
events.description: At night the entire zone dims the lights and we enter the TITANVEIL warzone where epic Kaiju strike your 3D Lunar Fortress. You can defend it with your choice of epic mechanical machinery, your own pet Kaiju, or even something more secretive... There's only one way to find out! Assemble your spacecraft, build your lunar base, choose your Kaiju or Mech and grab a chair to get started! It's compatible with any brand of Kaiju or Mecha or Ultra, so bring your collectibles and join the game.

events.description: The organization SHOT is the last line of defense against the Jamanga, the evil demon army lead by Dr. Wyrm and his evil henchmen. SHOT combats the enemy forces by deploying the Madan Warriors to engage in battle against them. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: Tsuburaya but not Ultraman!
events.description: A follow up to last year's successful Ultraman 101 panel. Tsuburaya Productions may be most famous for Ultraman, but has produced all manner of film and television shows over the years. This panel highlights and explores the kaiju and tokusatsu works of the studio that don't star Ultraman, including titles like Gridman, Mighty Jack, Booska and more! Hosted by Seismic Toys' Alex Rushdy.

events.title: Henshin Power V3 LIVE - Ultraman: The Wilderness Years
events.description: The Ultra Series was a pop cultural juggernaut for over a decade, but by 1981, competition with anime and other henshin heroes put the franchise on hiatus. For 15 years, there was no Ultraman on Japanese television. However, the Ultra Heroes weren’t idle. Join the hosts of the Henshin Power V3 podcast as they take you through an era of Ultra history that features spinoff series, foreign productions, and a handful of surprising movies.

events.title: Lucy and the Lake Monster
events.description: Lucy, an orphan girl, who believes in "Champ," the legendary sea serpent of Lake Champlain and her grandpa look for Champ despite mockery and mercenary forces opposing them. G-FEST Premiere - Q&A with Richard Rossi and Kelly Tabor

events.title: The Great Kaiju Hoax of 1947
events.description: In May of 1947, multiple american newspapers reported that a giant sea-monster had recently attacked Tokyo, at least according to a U.S. military radio broadcast. This broadcast would ultimately turn out to be a hoax in the style of Orson Welles' infamous War of the World's broadcast from 1938, but did it influence the creation of Godzilla? Join cultural studies scholar Justin Mullis for an in-depth look at this forgotten episode from kaiju history as well as similar hoaxes in this follow-up to G-FEST 2024's "From Cryptids to Kaiju" and 2025s "From Saucers to Seijin."

events.title: Brush of God
events.description: Legendary tokusatsu artist Keizo Murase gifted the world with one last golden egg in the shape of the 2024 film Brush of the God. A film that features the culmination of over 50 years worth of work and a history richer than any other modern kaiju movie. Join the minds behind the NEW Blu-ray release as they discuss this important film to kaiju history.

events.title: Kaiju Assault & Monster Match - Free Play
Cosplay Showcase
events.description: Want to strut your stuff in Cosplay but not ready for the big stage? The Cosplay Showcase is for you! Just sign up in person the day of and have your moment in the limelight!

events.title: Godzilla vs. Sea Monster: 60 Years of Lobster Fest
events.description: Tropical islands. Eyepatched terrorists. Giant shrimp. Bank robbers. "Godzilla vs. The Sea Monster" has it all, and it represented a massive tonal and stylistic shift in the Godzilla franchise when it released in 1966. Join the fun as this panel celebrates 60 years of the Red Bamboo, Mothra cameos, and, of course, the one and only Giant Condor.

events.title: Kaiju Conversation LIVE! 20 Years of Gamera: The Brave
events.description: In 2006, Kadokawa revived the Gamera franchise for a new film. Following the critically acclaimed Gamera Heisei trilogy, this new film faced many challenges in bringing the titanic turtle to new audiences. Unfortunately, the film didn’t meet expectations and has now become Gamera’s last film. Being designated as just a footnote in the franchise. Hear from the Kaiju Conversation podcast hosts, Elijah Thomas and Jackson Gibbens, alongside fellow podcasters Gratton Conwill and Matthew Fields, as they explore Gamera: The Brave, rediscovering and reevaluating this kaiju classic!

events.title: BraveStorm - The Forgotten Toku Revival
events.description: In 2017, an ambitious movie landed in Japan: BraveStorm, a reboot of Super Robot Red Baron and Silver Kamen. It could have launched a cinematic universe, but nothing ever came of it. What happened? Is BraveStorm a hidden gem or enjoyably bad? And what could the BraveStorm universe have looked like had it become reality? Ryan Goerge Collins (Omni Viewer, author) and Nathan Marchand (The Monster Island Film Vault, author) will answer these questions and more as they guide you through this forgotten reboot and speculate about what could have been.

events.title: The Prequel of the Evas: a touching tragic story tale
events.description: A group of mercenaries experiment with a teleporter that turns them into cyborg mechas knowns as evangelion. They regroup, but an unknown enemy threatens their existence. Will they neutralize this mysterious threat or be doomed for all eternity. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: Where Do Models Come From?
events.description: George Stephenson shares how the kits we love are produced. History of Geo-Metric and Black Heart models, resin, vinyl, 3D printing, and more.

events.title: Godzilla 1994
events.description: In 1994, Godzilla’s Hollywood career was set to kick off with an action-packed blockbuster directed by Jan de Bont. Then, it all came crashing down. How and why did this promising project never materialize? This panel will dive deep into the origins and plot of Godzilla's unmade epic and reveal why it failed to reach cinema screens.

events.title: Kaiju Anime Raids Again
events.description: A look at the many exciting kaiju developments in the anime medium since the previous panel on this topic 9 years ago.

events.title: Terry Morse and Godzilla
events.description: This panel explores the how and why of the first Americanized Godzilla film.

events.title: Ayura
events.description: As giant, mutated ayu (a sweetfish native to Japan) attacks the region, a government employee Kaoru and her senior Nanami deploy a cormorant-inspired robotic weapon called Meka-U to defend the populace. World Premiere

events.title: The Wind Up - Model Programming Feedback
events.description: Share your discoveries from the convention, talk about what you’d like to see next year, and give feedback on the model programming.

events.title: Gamera Guardian Of The Universe
events.description: Trace the epic evolution of Gamera—from Showa-era "Friend to All Children" in campy battles against Gyaos, Guiron, and more, to the darker Heisei trilogy's Atlantean guardian facing Gyaos, Legion, and Iris. Explore suit designs, practical effects, behind-the-scenes trivia, and the heartfelt Gamera Rebirth. A fiery celebration of this iconic kaiju's birthday bash as he turns 61!!

events.title: SRS Cinema Kaiju Showcase
events.description: Ron Bonk (President of SRS Cinema) and Elijah Thomas (Bonus Feature Producer) shed some light on the work behind one of the most prolific physical media labels releasing kaiju content. Expect some insider information, tasteful teases, and exclusive announcements.

events.title: Mike's House of Monsters G-FEST Special
events.description: What did we buy at G-FEST this year? Join an interactive conversation on the cool stuff we picked up at G-FEST!

events.title: War of the Gargantuas: The Frankenstein Brothers Turn 60
events.description: 1966 saw the premiere of War of the Gargantas, a classic kaiju film whose influence can still be felt in films like Kill Bill and Hot Fuzz. Come hear a panel discussion of this very unusual and enjoyable film.

events.title: Is It a Kaiju?
events.description: This panel explores the boundaries and metric of what defines a kaiju, by exploring other monsters, creatures and more. The goal is to both challenge and expand the idea of what a kaiju is.

events.title: Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker - Documentary
events.description: Formally blessed by the Murase Family, this brings together more than two-dozen collaborators, friends, family members, fans, and historians to celebrate the life, works, and legacy of Keizo Murase. G-FEST Premiere

events.title: DESTROY ALL RAPPERS - Making a Godzilla Mixtape
events.description: Learn how rapper J-Zilla and producer Tillysteezebeats used the iconic sounds of the Showa Godzilla era soundtracks to craft a nostalgic body of work that fans of kaiju, old school hip-hop, and movie soundtracks will all love.

events.title: Kaiju Konfessions
events.description: It's time to pack up G-FEST for another year. Join the celebration of Kaiju song and dance! What's a monster movie without a catchy tune? Now it's time to participate in the fun! Join us! Let's SAVE THE EARTH!!!
